_about: Template for NERSC Perlmutter (GPU nodes, A100). Copy it, set "prefix", adjust, then run:
python3 install.py --config cfg_perlmutter.json             (build, inside an interactive job)
Keys starting with '_' are comments. Command-line options override this file.
The "machine" entry below is the machine profile (modules, compilers, flags);
its "defaults" set GPU and BLAS. Override them by adding e.g. "gpu": false or
"blas": "mkl" at the top level, or edit the profile. See README.md.
int64 (off with invDFT), petsc (on with invDFT) and elpa_gpu (on with gpu) are
derived automatically; see README.md before setting them here.
Set "invdft": false to install DFT-FE only (then 64-bit integers are used).
For the CPU partition set "gpu": false (the profile then loads the 'cpu' module).

_notes: NERSC Perlmutter: HPE Cray EX, AMD EPYC (znver3) + NVIDIA A100 (sm_80).
Based on the perlmutterDevelop branch of dftfeDevelopers/install_DFTFE.
ELPA's SIMD kernels are disabled, as in the original scripts.
CPU-only builds load the 'cpu' module instead of the GPU modules.
machine.description: NERSC Perlmutter (HPE Cray EX, AMD EPYC + NVIDIA A100)

_prefix: REQUIRED: install directory for DFT-FE/invDFT and env.sh; set it here or pass --prefix
_prefix_dependencies: optional: separate install directory for the dependencies (null = same as prefix); set it here or pass --prefix-dependencies
_scalar_type: DFT-FE executables: real (molecules, Gamma point), complex (k-points) or both; with PETSc, PETSc/SLEPc/deal.II are built for the same type(s); invDFT needs real or both
_dccl: true links NCCL from the nccl module; useful for very large systems
